arxiv-2110-14699.description: Abstract . Este trabalho apresenta um estudo exploratório sobre os efeitos da arquitetura dirigida a eventos na modularização de software . arxiv-2112-13762.title: MSeg: A Composite Dataset for Multi-domain Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2112-13762.creator: John Lambert, Zhuang Liu, Ozan Sener, James Hays, and Vladlen Koltun
arxiv-2112-13762.description: Abstract We present MSeg, a composite dataset that unifies semantic segmentation datasets from different domains. A naive merge of the constituent datasets yields poor performance due to inconsistent taxonomies and annotation practices. We reconcile the taxonomies and bring the pixel-level annotations into alignment by relabeling more than 220,000 object masks in more than 80,000 images, requiring more than 1.

arxiv-2208-02443.title: Credal Valuation Networks for Machine Reasoning Under Uncertainty
arxiv-2208-02443.creator: Branko Ristic, Alessio Benavoli, Sanjeev Arulampalam
arxiv-2208-02443.description: Abstract Contemporary undertakings provide limitless opportunities for widespread application of machine reasoning and artificial intelligence in situations characterised by uncertainty, hostility and sheer volume of data. The paper develops a valuation network as a graphical system for higher-level fusion and reasoning under uncertainty in support of the human operators.

arxiv-2209-09775.title: FedToken: Tokenized Incentives for Data Contribution in Federated Learning
arxiv-2209-09775.creator: Shashi Raj Pandey, Lam Duc Nguyen, Petar Popovski
arxiv-2209-09775.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shashi Raj Pandey, Lam Duc Nguyen, Petar Popovski. Incentives that compensate for the involved costs in the decentralized training of a Federated Learning (FL) model act as a key stimulus for clients’ long-term participation. However, it is challenging to convince clients for quality participation in FL due to the absence of: (i) full information on the client’s data quality and properties; (ii) the value of client’s data contributions; and (iii) the trusted mechanism for monetary incentive offers.

arxiv-2306-10296.title: OpenSBT: A Modular Framework for Search-based Testing of Automated Driving Systems
arxiv-2306-10296.creator: Lev Sorokin, Tiziano Munaro, Damir Safin, Brian Hsuan-Cheng Liao, Adam Molin
arxiv-2306-10296.description: Abstract . Search-based software testing (SBST) is an effective and efficient approach for testing automated driving systems (ADS). However, testing pipelines for ADS testing are particularly challenging as they involve integrating complex driving simulation platforms and establishing communication protocols and APIs with the desired search algorithm.

arxiv-2509-00551.title: Elliptic surfaces to class groups and Selmer groups
arxiv-2509-00551.creator: Kalyan Banerjee, Kalyan Chakraborty and Azizul Hoque
arxiv-2509-00551.description: Abstract . In this note, we connect the n n -torsions of the Picard group of an elliptic surface to the n n -divisibility of the class group of torsion fields for a given integer n > 1 n>1 . We also connect the n n -divisibility of the Selmer group to that of the class group of torsion fields.

arxiv-2602-06351.creator: Longhui Ma, Di Zhao, Siwei Wang, Zhao Lv, Miao Wang
arxiv-2602-06351.description: Abstract GUI grounding maps natural language instructions to the correct interface elements, serving as the perception foundation for GUI agents. Existing approaches predominantly rely on fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using large-scale GUI datasets to predict target element coordinates, which is data-intensive and generalizes poorly to unseen interfaces.

pmc-11417507.creator: Danica Rotar Pavlič, Alem Maksuti, Nena Kopčavar Guček, Islam Albaradi, Aleksander Stepanović
pmc-11417507.description: BackgroundThe use of e-cigarettes has been rapidly expanding in recent years. The reasons people in Slovenia chose to use electronic cigarettes have not been studied to date. This study examines e-cigarette users' attitudes regarding their health risks.ObjectivesThe aim of the study was to examine the users' standpoint towards e-cigarettes and their understanding of the impact on people's health.

pmc-12485543.description: Edith Luhanga is an assistant research professor at Carnegie Mellon University Africa in Rwanda. pmc-13181112.description: The clinical treatment of castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) is currently a major challenge. CCK-8 and CellTiter-Glo assays were used to evaluate the viability of CRPC cells after treatment.

pmc-13580537.title: Microwave diffractive neural network chips for sensing and computing
pmc-13580537.creator: Lei Chen, Qian Wen Wu, Ze Gu, Qian Ma, Lei Xiao, Zhao Tian, Wen Qi Su, Hao Yang Cui, Jian Wei You, Tie Jun Cui
pmc-13580537.description: Electromagnetic diffractive neural networks (DNNs) enable ultra–low-power, low-latency artificial intelligence (AI) inference, yet optical implementations suffer from fabrication and scalability limits, and metasurface microwave systems remain bulky. We present a chip-scale microwave diffractive neural network (MDNN) fabricated in a GaAs semiconductor process, integrating cascaded couplers and phase shifters to implement a diffraction network within a millimeter-scale footprint.
